title: Corgi Dash Run
description: Dash down sunny park paths with an adorable short-legged Corgi—leap puddles, grab tasty bone treats, and sprint for cheerful endless scores.
controls: Tap or swipe to dodge obstacles, leap hurdles, and scoop up bones along the park lane.

zh-CN.title: 冲吧柯基小狗
zh-CN.description: 萌翻全场的治愈系冲吧柯基小狗：操控圆屁股小柯基一路撒欢奔跑、越过障碍叼骨头，开心减压一整天！
zh-CN.controls: 点击或滑动操控小柯基跳跃变道躲避障碍，一路收集美味狗骨头刷新高分。
